use_cases: Creating magnetic pull effects on CTA buttons that draw toward the cursor
Adding delightful hover interactions to navigation menu items
Implementing magnetic attraction on interactive card components
Enhancing icon buttons with cursor-following motion effects
Building eye-catching links that magnetically respond to mouse proximity
ai_summary: A motion primitive component that creates a physics-based magnetic attraction effect, pulling wrapped elements toward the cursor using spring animations. This behavioral wrapper applies to any children and responds to mouse proximity within a configurable range, making it ideal for adding premium micro-interactions to buttons, cards, and navigation elements in web applications.
